cards.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
cards.summaryOriginal: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of…
cards.summaryEn: Proposes runtime adaptation of prefill-decode disaggregated LLM serving to agent workloads, rebalancing compute and KV cache to cut load imbalance.
cards.summaryKo: 에이전트 워크로드에 맞춰 LLM 서빙의 연산과 KV 캐시를 실행 중 조정하는 방법을 제안한다.

cards.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
cards.summaryOriginal: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failur…
cards.summaryEn: Method for quantizing LLM agents to low bit-width while preserving task success, using closed-loop teacher steering to correct behavior divergences.
cards.summaryKo: 작업 성공률을 지키며 LLM 에이전트를 저비트로 양자화하고 교사 모델로 행동을 교정하는 기법이다.

cards.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
cards.summaryOriginal: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read…
cards.summaryEn: Reading control layer that admits only sparse evidence from web pages and tool outputs, cutting token and latency costs for AI agents.
cards.summaryKo: 웹과 도구 응답에서 필요한 근거만 읽어 AI 에이전트의 토큰과 지연 시간을 줄이는 읽기 제어 계층이다.

cards.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
cards.summaryOriginal: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction mo…
cards.summaryEn: Framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models with simulated users in interactive physical-task environments.
cards.summaryKo: 시뮬레이션 사용자와 상호작용하며 시각 상호작용 모델을 폐루프로 평가하고 학습하는 프레임워크다.

cards.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
cards.summaryOriginal: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380…
cards.summaryEn: Large corpus that turns 2,118 university math textbooks into structured proof supervision data, keeping curricular and evidential structure.

cards.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
cards.summaryOriginal: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble…
cards.summaryEn: Prompt-adaptive, cost-aware router that picks one LLM per request, with an ensemble extension (PISA-E) to balance quality and inference cost.
cards.summaryKo: 요청마다 LLM 하나를 골라 품질과 추론 비용을 맞추는 라우터와 앙상블 확장 PISA-E를 제안한다.

cards.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
cards.summaryOriginal: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and apply…
cards.summaryEn: Reinforcement learning method that lets LLMs autonomously retrieve, study and apply knowledge in unfamiliar domains, beyond standard RAG.
cards.summaryKo: 낯선 도메인에서 LLM이 스스로 지식을 검색하고 학습하고 적용하도록 강화학습으로 훈련하는 방법이다.

cards.title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
cards.summaryOriginal: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control.
